mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of months when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in 60% or more of months when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating economic expansion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in less than 55% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO growth above 1% quarterly) signals robust manufacturing expansion, preceding strong corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of quarters when INDPRO growth exceeds 1% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: A low annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL growth below 2%) signals stable price levels, reducing uncertainty and supporting higher equity valuations for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of months when CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 growth above 2.0%) indicates robust economic expansion, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in 60% or more of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and spending for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in less than 55% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 100k and UNRATE decreases by at least 0.2 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A housing boom (HOUST above 1600 thousand units) signals strong housing demand, acting as a leading indicator for economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 40% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1600 thousand units.
